english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial verb for making a room or things neat and putting them in order.

examples.english: I need to tidy my room now.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 zap1 gaan1 fong2

english.note: Use this when picking up or gathering things from the ground or from different places.

examples.english: I’ll pick up the papers on the floor for you.
examples.jyutping: dei6 haa6 di1 zi2 ngo5 bong1 nei5 zap1 faan1
